preconditions.description: The number of rooms n is an integer between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and 1 <= v <= 10**6 for x, y, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects rooms x and y with a tunnel time v, where x and y are distinct room indices between 1 and n, and v is a positive integer up to 1,000,000.
The input graph is a tree with exactly n-1 edges.
The number of queries q is an integer between 1 and 50 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= 10**11 for l in l_values)
preconditions.description: Each query value l is a positive integer up to 10^11.
The number of l values matches the query count q.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly q lines, one for each query value of l.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(line, str) and line.strip().isdigit() for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line is a valid integer representing the maximum number of children for the corresponding l.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(line) <= n for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output integer is between 1 and n (inclusive), representing a feasible subset of rooms.

postconditions.expression: all(connected_subset(rooms, tree) and max_diff(rooms, tree) <= l for l, line in zip(l_values, output_lines) if (rooms := find_rooms(int(line), tree, l)) is not None)
postconditions.description: For each l, the output integer k corresponds to a subset of rooms of size k that is connected and satisfies the maximum arrival time difference constraint (max_diff ≤ l). The subset is chosen to maximize k.

postconditions.expression: all(not exists_subset_larger(rooms, tree, l, k) for l, k in zip(l_values, map(int, output_lines)) if (rooms := find_rooms(k, tree, l)) is not None)
postconditions.description: For each l, the output integer k is the maximum possible size of a connected subset of rooms satisfying max_diff ≤ l.

invariants.description: The tree structure is built from the input edges, representing the hole's rooms and tunnels.
The leaves of the tree are the rooms connected directly to the ground via vertical tunnels.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= distance_to_ground(room, tree) <= max_distance for room in range(1, n + 1))
invariants.description: For each room, distance_to_ground(room, tree) is the length of the farthest path to any leaf (ground exit).
